evidence_quotes: 27 earthquakes were recorded across Indonesian regions over the 31-day monitoring window
busiest single day being 14 February (4 events)
Magnitudes ranged from M4.0 to M5.7, with an average of M4.63
Tobelo dominated activity, accounting for 19 of 27 events (70%), with the remaining 8 centered on Tual
a M5.5 shallow-focus quake (depth just 5.4 km) near Tual on 27 January flagged a tsunami warning
a M4.8 at only 2.0 km depth near Tual (14 Feb) and a M4.5 at 3.3 km depth near Tobelo (14 Feb)
criticisms: The report describes the monitoring window as '31-day' but the digest runs from 2026-01-17 to 2026-02-16, which is exactly 30 days — a very minor off-by-one rounding issue, not a material error.

The report characterizes the 27 January M5.5 event as triggering a 'tsunami warning' — the digest only flags tsunami=true, which typically indicates a tsunami alert was issued, but the exact nature (warning vs. watch vs. advisory) cannot be confirmed from the digest alone. This is a slight overspecification of metadata.
